The upper bound 537 is a checked clique cover; no linear code improved it (F_2, c=1 gave length above 536). Against the baselines, the agent's bracket is tighter on both sides: lower 336 vs 294 (cpsat_alpha) and 293 (f2_minrank_sat, kushagra_agent), and upper 537 vs 994 (frac_cover) and 998 (kushagra_agent). Times are similar: wall 121.0 s (llm 54.7 s, compute 66.3 s) against baselines of about 120 s, except f2_minrank_sat at 0.79 s, which only gives a lower bound of 293. The graph's non-integral spectrum fits a random 6-regular graph, so it is no surprise that algebraic codes found no gain. Nothing looks suspicious.
